sentences.en: There were several stars to be seen in the sky.
sentences.zh: 天空中可以看到几颗星星。

sentences.en: The strong wind cut the electric wires in several places.
sentences.zh: 强风在几个地方切断了电线。

sentences.en: It took me several days to balance the company books.
sentences.zh: 我花了好几天才把公司的账目算平。

senses.zh: 几个的，数个的；各自的，分别的
